notes.title: Update, Fixes
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone for the notes on the last build. We’re happy to report we’ve just updated the game with the latest build that addresses:
[list]
[*]Floating bodies – they’re now back on the ground where they are supposed to be!
[*]Screen anomalies  when enemies are prone – they still will shoot at you though so hey be careful out there.
[/list]
